report.answer_text: Chelsea FC won the 2025 FIFA Club World Cup, beating Paris Saint-Germain 3–0 in the final. The tournament was hosted by the United States, and the final was played on July 13, 2025, at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey. (fifa.com)
